verdict.rationale: The docs show Elasticsearch's core capabilities are exposed programmatically: hybrid and vector search run in one API request, the inference API configures endpoints, and official client libraries cover most popular languages. Nothing in the evidence states that the API matches everything the UI (Kibana, Cloud console) can do. The 404 on OpenAPI probe paths under elastic.co is not a concrete contradiction, only a missing published spec at those locations. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, documented API coverage of management, console and Kibana UI functions, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Elasticsearch is easy to use from most popular programming languages, thanks to the wide range of official libraries and developer tools available.
Vector and hybrid search, reranking, and GPU inference in one API.
The inference API workflow is more complex but offers greater control over the inference endpoint configuration.
Hybrid search runs full-text search and vector search in one request.
